title: CheckDescriptor
description: Metadata every integrity check carries in the check registry (scripts/check_data.py). The OPERATIONS table of checks is generated from these, so a check cannot exist without its meaning and its playbook, and the docs cannot drift from the code.

name.description: The exact prefix used in checks.json strings today, e.g. duplicate_id, present_count_drift.

severity.description: hard blocks the commit (exit 2); soft is recorded; stat is a number to watch.

why.description: One sentence: the failure this check exists to catch.

threshold.description: Tolerance in words, e.g. 'max(50, 1%)'; null for boolean checks.

reading.description: How to interpret a firing: what is expected background versus a real problem.

playbook.description: What to do, as verbs: 'ts repair rewrite-records', 'ts doctor', etc.

since.description: Date the check was introduced; lets an agent tell old from new signals.

expected_background.description: A known steady-state value or range (e.g. present_count_drift ~350 until the API backfill) so a firing can be compared with normal.
